batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b R Tewatia

batting.dismissal: c C Sakariya b Mustafizur Rahman

batting.name: LS Livingstone
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Avesh Khan

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b A Nortje

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: st RR Pant b R Ashwin

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b A Nortje

balls.text: a full toss, and Ashwin gets it down to long on. Some loping strides, and he's back for the second

they pick up two where there should have been a run-out! Let's break this down for you. It's a length ball, angled across, where Ashwin looks to play the reverse flick. Gets no bat on it. Is slow to react to the call from Lalit, and Samson throws it to the Fizz, who fails to run Ashwin out. And they get an overthrow
gets a hold of this. Pulled towards square leg. A misfield allows them two
length, slower in the air. Driven firmly towards long off
Ashwin looks to pull, and hits it hard on to his pads. Went deep inside the crease hoping to create some room
length, but angles across him. An ugly hoick across the line takes it on the bounce towards deep midwicket
Ashwin backs away down the leg side, and Sakariya sends down a fuller, slower ball outside off. No contact made
short, into the pitch, and he pulls this away. Not in complete control, but has kept it along the ground towards deep square leg
length, worked away towards point and they pinch a single
length, worked away towards midwicket

pulls a short ball just outside off, down Miller's throat at long on. Patel cannot believe how precisely he has placed it. He walked towards the ball a bit, and inadvertently ended up cramping himself for room. May have actually wanted to go straighter down the ground, but Sakariya is not complaining
cat and mouse between batter and bowler here! Patel shapes for the swat outside off, and Sakariya responds by going a touch wide. Just beyond the tramlines, though
length, around off, and Patel flogs this down the wicket. Wasn't sure at first myself of how well he had timed it, but he got enough and more! Clears long on by a long distance

this is clever! The extra ball has cost them four runs. Lalit gets down to play a lap, and just gets it beyond the man at square leg. No protection in the deep. Just uses the pace of what was intended to be another full pitched delivery

that's better. A yorker around off, and Lalit Yadav looks to play the sweep off the front foot. There's an appeal for caught behind from the keeper, but that was never going to be given. Probably just nudged his back leg
full toss, around off, and driven to long off. He's searching for the perfect yorker at the moment
wide outside the off stump this time. Patel was backing away a touch, and he fires this across him, but overcooks it in the process
length, but down the leg side. Patel does well to let this go to give his team an extra ball
looks for the yorker, but ends up with a low full toss outside off. Driven down the ground to long off
fuller, whipped away towards deep midwicket
slower ball, on the pads, and worked away towards long leg. The chase between deep square and short fine leg is won by the former in getting across to cut it off
short, around off, and cut away. There's a deep point in place
yorker again. Digs it out from around off, and gets it down to long on
seam up, angles into Patel, who runs it towards short third and picks up a quick single

yorker, and he looks to go down the ground. Off the edge, and taken at short third. Easy catch for Sakariya, as Hetmyer throws his head back in disappointment. Terrific hand, but Delhi would have willed him on to carry on for atleast another couple of overs
outstanding yorker! Just outside off, and Hetmyer unwittingly made it even more difficult for himself by moving towards the ball. Just brought his bat down quite late on it
length, slower ball, that cutter again. Lalit was backing away looking to swat it away. Adjusted late and just worked it away towards point for a single

great, late adjustment! Hetmyer had begun backing away again, and Tyagi followed him with a short ball into his body. Hetmyer gets low down and then dabs this over short third. Smart, and effective. A couple of decent overs in recent times for Delhi
looks for the yorker, around off, and he drives this hard towards long off
outside off, and driven from a length towards deep cover
through the same region. Superb batting! Played his hand by backing away again, and this was a shorter length (for one, it pitched) and he slashes this hard between short third and point
full toss, around off, and he backs away a touch and slashes this through point. No boundary rider behind square on the off side, and it was always going for four once it went past point
he has got this all wrong! Hetmyer backs away to open up the off side, and Tyagi looks to fire it wide. Goes well beyond the tramlines, though
full, on the pads, and going down leg. Yadav was looking to whip it away towards square leg, but is called through for a quick leg bye
length, around off, and he drops it towards point and pinches a quick single
slower ball, outside off, and he walks across the stumps to open up the legside. Works it away towards deep midwicket

takes a step towards the bowler, and then absolutely thrashes this towards long on. There's a fielder there, but he sees the ball bounce near him and then speed further away. Diving attempt, but cannot get to it
length, around off, and a change up in pace from Sakariya. Hetmyer has a big heave-ho, but fails to make contact. Was looking to go down the ground
dug in a bit short, but yet again, width on offer. Slapped away through the cover region. Aerial, but safe. Teaser for wide long-off, but he doesn't get there
length, but a lot of width on offer. Driven firmly through the extra cover region. The sweeper is a bit more square than normal, and he gets across to it around his left
just a touch short, around off, and he whips it away off the backfoot towards deep midwicket
fuller, and driven towards deep mid-off
flatter, down the leg side, and he looks to whip it away. Cannot beat short fine leg
length, around off, and he stretches forward to defend

that could be gone! Drew him forward by tossing it up, and throwing it a touch wide. Iyer took the bait, and saw the ball spin across his blade, and then Samson was quick to whip the bails off. The Royals captain looks quite confident, but it does seem Iyer had his foot grounded, at first glance. Outstanding bit of bowling from Tewatia, nonetheless. Seems to have read a hint of restlessness on the part of the batter. No edge on this. And he had failed to stretch his back foot back in! Pant, and now Iyer. Capitals have some work to do now to get themselves up to the kind of total they should be aiming for
full, wide, and Iyer looks to drive, but gets the bottom of the bat. Back to the bowler
worked off the back foot towards midwicket

down the wicket, and chips this towards deep midwicket. Loud shots of "catch it" ring out around the ground, but wide long on was a touch slow to get across to it. Stayed up for a while, but was placed reasonably well
fuller, and Hetmyer goes for the slog sweep. On the bounce towards Jaiswal at deep midwicket
hangs back in the crease, and plays one that goes the other way across him towards midwicket. Wants two, but has to settle for a single
short, and down leg side, and Iyer tries to spank this over short fine leg. Ends up mistiming it. Goes along the ground to the fielder there
length around off, and he pushes it towards cover to get off strike
angles in towards him and he works it off his hips towards deep square leg
length ball, seam up, angles into him, and worked away towards short midwicket now in place

plays this one on! Back of a length is the way to go on this pitch, it would seem. Short, and outside off, and Pant was looking to hook this away towards deep square leg. Ends up getting an under edge, and has to trudge off. Royals with an important breakthrough, because this partnership was beginning to look a touch ominous for them

biffed back down the field. Livingstone comes around from long on and is just able to reel it back. Outstanding bit of work, since he had to scoop it up behind his back. Was a length ball, close to Pant's arc, and he wanted to take full toll of it
length, and Iyer walks across the stumps to open up the onside. Able to work it away towards midwicket
spanking drive to a delivery that was on a length, just outside off. There's a sweeper cover in place, though
hangs back in his crease and can wait for this to turn away from him, before cutting it away towards deep point
whips this away towards deep midwicket

an inventive bit of batting from Iyer. Picks it up from around leg, and just does a little reverse dabble over Samson and gets it down towards third man. Pulled back by Mustafizur Rahman chasing it down from short third

makes some room for himself by backing away to the leg side. Shamsi follows suit by firing it over a touch wide, but that only gives Iyer with some more room to work with. Absolutely swatted over extra cover
fuller length, and he plays this with the turn towards cow corner. Will pick up two before deep midwicket can get around to this
short of a length, a touch wide, and slapped away towards sweeper cover
comes down, and makes room. Goes down to sweep this full ball on middle to deep midwicket
much fuller on off, and driven to long-on with the full face of the bat
rammed back over the bowler's head! This is bowled slow, and full outside off. Iyer is across off, and swings his bat full stretch to send that for the maximum
pulls his length back to go short on middle and off, and Pant cuts to deep point
sweeps, but gets an inside edge on to his pad. Appeal for leg before, but not given. Pitches on a full length, but outside leg
very full and straight on middle. Driven down to deep midwicket
fuller on off, and Pant drives to find the man at extra cover, who is right at the edge of the circle
chipped, but safe! The ball lands in the acres of space toward deep point, as Shamsi bowls the wrong 'un from a good length on middle
short in length, and just outside off. Turning away, and cut to deep point
goes down on his back knee, and sweeps to fine leg! Full delivery on middle and off, and the man at short fine leg remains unmoved, with the ball swept to his right
turns into the batter off a full length on leg. Clipped to the man at deep square
skips down to this pretty full ball on middle, and heaves that away to deep square, where is a wide gap, with the man at deep square slightly straightish
shortish and just outside off, and point dives to his right to stop that! That stops a certain run or two
full and straighter on off. Flicked to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
fullish and a touch wide of off. Cover dives to his left, but is beaten, as the ball races to long-on
fuller and just outside off. He pushes that to cover, and they complete a quick single
short and wide of off, and Pant slashes that away from his body after going down on his back knee and making room too. Deep point gives the chase to his right
short of a length on middle, and runs that down to deep midwicket with the full face of the bat
pretty full on off, and driven to long-off with the full face of the bat. Just six singles from that Shamsi over
very full and straighter on middle. Defends with a closed face of the bat toward square leg, as both keeper and bowler chase the ball
short of a length again on off with a hint of turn into him, and he pushes it to long-on's right from deep in his crease
shortish in length, and wide of off. Turns a touch away from him, as he cuts to deep point
low full-toss on off, and Iyer clips that to long-on with a slightly closed face of the bat
Pant skips down, and drives this full ball outside off to long-on powerfully
direct hit from mid-off, but Pant looks safe! Sakariya picks that up early, as Pant drives forward to a really full ball on off and takes off
good length ball on middle, and Pant jabs that back to the on side
Typical Pant! Fine leg is inside the circle, and Tyagi bowls short and wide of leg. Pant swivels, and pulls that over the fielder for four, although he is almost falling over there
good length delivery just outside off, and Pant finds the cover fielder with his punch
in the driving length on a pretty length outside off, and driven to deep point forcefully
much fuller, but pretty wide of off too. Angles away, and is called wide
Cut away, and beats deep point to his right! Short and wide of off, and Iyer plays away from his body while stretching out
fullish length just outside off and at 136kph too. Pant pushes at that, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to mid-on
short delivery on off, that gets good bounce too. Iyer pulls that to deep midwicket after riding the bounce
change of pace again. Full and just outside off, and clipped to square leg for another single
slower ball now. On a good length on off, as Iyer is deep in his crease before he flicks it to square leg after stepping across a touch
and Pant dances down first ball. It is fullish on off, and Pant closes the bat face to push it to mid-on for a rapid run

slices that, and balloons it to mid-off! Shaw makes a touch of room to this full ball on middle and off, which is also angling away. Looks to go over the in-field with that loft, but can only sky that to Livingstone, as Royals strike again. The left-armer's angle working there for Royals
yorker length ball on off, and jammed back to the bowler. Excellent delivery that one, as Tyagi starts off with a wicket and just three from his first over
lofts that fuller ball on off over Tewatia now, and that lands to the right of the man at deep point. Quick two for Iyer there
good diving stop by Tewatia at cover. Shortish in length again, but closer to off stump, as Iyer lunges forward to drive that
shortish in length, and pitches wide of off. Continues to angle away, and is called wide
short delivery which is slightly wide of off, and Iyer is beaten on his pull
very full ball and in the channel outside off. Iyer stays deep in his crease, and drives that with the full face of the bat, but finds the man at cover

chopped on! Tyagi strikes first ball, although he has some luck favouring him. Good length ball on middle and off, as Dhawan looks to tap at that. Doesn't quite take off from the surface too, as it comes off the lower half of the bat, and bounces just in front of the stumps before rolling over to hit them. Dhawan barely has time to kick that away, as he walks back with a wry smile
another short delivery on off, and this Shaw bisects deep midwicket and fine leg with his pull. Two more runs to the total
short of a length on off, and pulled to deep square leg, as the fielder runs across to his left. Shaw is almost easing with that second run, but Dhawan hurries back
this time Shaw finds the gap with his drive, as he crunches that full ball outside off to deep point, who runs to his right to cut that off
one more. This is on a good length and a touch wide of off, as Shaw has a slash at that away from his body, but can't get any contact with the ball
and again a change of pace. Very full and just outside off, as Shaw jams that to mid-off
starts with a slower ball right away. A dipping and very full ball on middle and off at just 101kph, as Dhawan comes down and makes room to push that to the on side
stays leg side of the ball, but still can't find the gap as he drives this very full ball on off
drives this full ball on off full stretch, but finds the man at cover
makes room to this very full ball on off, and drills that to long-on
goes to sweep this full ball a touch outside off, but is beaten. The ball takes the keeper's glove and flies off to the leg side
fumble at cover-point this time. Dhawan drives forward to this full ball on off, and beats the man at cover to his right
shortish and wide of off, and Dhawan cuts from the bottom of the bat. The point fielder dives to his right, but can't get a hand
slower ball, and on a full length on his pads. Flicked behind to fine leg, as Shaw has to wait for the ball to come
skips down, as Fizz bowls a low full-toss on middle, which Dhawan clips to deep square leg after making room
mid-off dives to his right, and gets a hand to keep that to a single. Another ball with a scrambled seam, but this is really full on off, as Shaw opens the bat face to drive that forward
gets a leading edge this time. Tris to turn this good length ball on middle and leg around to the on side, but is not control of that shot
another good length ball, and a touch wide of off. Change of pace too, with this one at 125kph. Pushed through to deep point
on a good length on middle and leg, as Shaw walks across off and clips that to deep square leg
And that's that. Full on middle, and driven down towards long on
inside out, for six! Avesh puts this on a length, just around off, and he smacks this through the extra cover region. Made no attempt to keep it down. Or run.
fuller, outside off, and driven firmly towards sweeper cover
length, outside off, and he looks to drive this down the ground. On the bounce through towards long on
slower ball, into the pitch, and Samson looks to set himself up for the drive but has to check his shot. Fielded on his follow-through by Avesh
full toss, and he flogs this outside off. Driven towards sweeper cover
slower ball, into the body of Samson, who works it away towards deep midwicket
back of a length, and he again plans to go for the reverse shovel. Just misses out
full, down the leg side, and will have to rebowl this again

length, played inside out towards sweeper cover. Dhawan gets to the ball, and drops it promptly. Not sure what went wrong there. It wasn't as if he was looking into the sun. Probably was thinking about his trademark thigh-five celebration?
short, but slow. Samson looks late to get this over short third, but fails to make contact. Completely deceived by the lack of pace on that off-cutter
looks for the yorker. Just down the leg side, and will be called a wide
full, and he walks across the crease to his left, and then just delicately dinks it over short third. Smart again from Samson
full from Rabada and he can't quite get it away. Refuses a potential single on offer
yorker, on off stump. Steered to third man
still full, and up in pace. Played towards cover, and that helps him get off the strike
full, around off, and he is able to keep it out. Wants one, but has to scurry back into his crease
length, around off, and he drives it to point
short, and looks to pull it. Cannot keep it down, and it goes straight down Hetmyer's throat at deep square leg. Just has to move a bit to his left, and that's good enough to pull this catch off
driven hard, but straight to Rabada on the edge of the circle at cover
full toss, outside off, and he looks to drive this down the ground. Just on a bounce to long off
yorker, and he digs it out. They go through for a quick single
full, around off, and he looks to go towards deep midwicket. A bounce towards long on. Just not able to get any traction with his attempted big hits
length, looks to drive down the ground. Off the inside edge, but misses the stumps. Runs away towards short fine, and he can pick up one
full, down the leg side. Will have to rebowl this
length, and he chips this wide of long on. Wants two immediately, and comes back for it easily too. Fifty up for Samson
full, outside off, and he looks to play the lap. Only able to get it towards deep midwicket
a touch wide of off, and driven hard towards sweeper cover
length, straighter in line, worked away with the incoming slant towards deep midwicket
length, and he goes back to punch this towards deep midwicket. Dhawan goes across from long on and fields, but cannot prevent two form being taken
this time he nails the reverse sweep. Just in the arc outside off, and he is able to get it across over short third man
Samson looks for the reverse sweep, but fails to make contact. Fired in a touch quicker
Tewatia goes down on one knee and flogs this with a reverse swipe across the line. It's a length ball outside off, originally, and he gets it away to deep point

back to back boundaries! Sanju Samson on the charge. Another slow off-cutter, and he has just whipped this away towards the deep square leg boundary. Perfectly bisected the gap between deep backward square and deep midwicket
slower ball, and just outside off. Mid off inside the circle, and he has just cleared the man there with a lofted drive. Almost a horizontal bat shot, and allows the ball to come to him
length ball, angles across him, and he punches it away towards deep cover
length, punched off the backfoot towards deep point
shot! It's rapid from Rabada, but down the leg side, and he just helps it along the way, and places it to the left of short fine leg. Just a flick of the wrists, that's all!
slower ball, outside off, and steered to point
length, and he plays this lofted, but safely, towards long on
short, and he looks to hook this away. A bit ungainly in execution, but is able to get it down on the bounce towards fine leg
fuller, Tewatia wants to work it away through midwicket. On to his pads, though. Wants a quick leg bye, but is sent back by Samson
back of a length, hard into the pitch, but ample time on this slow pitch to work it off his legs towards deep midwicket
short, steered past the keeper. Smart batting from Samson, as he plays it really late. Dug in short, and outside off, and he took full advantage of the limited space given
length, and he has looked to take him down the ground. Off the inside and skews high in the air, but lands safely around cow corner. Just drops dead right about there, well short of the boundary
looks for the reverse sweep, but gets it off the pad. Runs away towards short third. Pant lets out an appeal on the higher side of the human phonetic scale. All normal then
driven firmly, but straight to cover
goes wide of the crease, and tries to fire this down the legside. Probably was anticipating a shimmy down the track from Samson, but ends up bowling it wide
floated in closer to the batter, and he works it off his leg towards square leg
slower through the air, and he dabs it towards short third. Wants a single, but there's none on offer
tries to run this towards third man. Short third is quick to get to it
floated in around leg and middle, and he pushes this towards short midwicket
length, outside off, punched towards long off
fired in quicker, and he looks to play this across the line, and misses out. Parag misses. Patel hits. Rajasthan sink further deep
length, goes back to drive this, but cannot beat point
works this one with the incoming slant towards deep midwicket
late cut, and superbly played. Just gets it to the left of short third man. Cleverly uses the pace of a length ball outside off
length, driven firmly towards long off
driven towards deep cover, moving forward to meet the ball. Helps prevent this from being a wicket maiden
yorker, dipping into Parag, who has jammed his bat down just in time
length, outside off, and he has a nibble at that. No edge, though
length, outside off, swings further away. Left alone

helps a short ball down deep fine leg's throat! Dug in short by Rabada, and Lomror might have been intending to play this a bit squarer. Cannot keep it down, and a grateful Avesh Khan gobbles this one up. Exposes the slight underbelly that this batting lineup has for Rajasthan
length, around off, and defended
full delivery outside off, and clipped to long-on with the closed face of the bat
reverse-sweeps again, but finds short third man, as Axar goes full and outside off
fuller on off, and skids on. Pushed to the man at cover
short and wide of off. Cut to deep point with the width available
another pretty full ball on off, and driven to long-off. Cover dives to his right, but in vain
full delivery on middle, and driven to long-on for another single
chips this good length ball on off which is straightening toward him. A single down to long-off
tossed up on a full length outside off. Slashed to point
fuller on off, with a hint of turn away. Clipped to deep square with the closed face of the bat
flicks this good length ball to deep square, with the ball again sliding down leg
cracks that over the bowler's head! Shimmies down to get to the pitch of this good length ball on off, which threatens to come in, and has a full swing
full and straight on off, driven right down to the man at cover
another full delivery on off which is driven to long-on, as Pant calls "easy, easy, easy" from behind
this is again flighted a touch on a full length outside off, as Samson drives to deep point
slow, and full just outside off. Tossed up as well, as Samson defends to cover
short and really wide of off. He could have well left that alone, but cuts that to deep point away from his body
much fuller on off, and he closes the bat face to clip that to deep midwicket
full ball pitching outside leg, and wide is called
full ball on off at 104kpg, and that is clipped toward long-on
very full on off, and pushed back to the bowler's right
tossed up on a full length just outside off. Driven down to long-off with the full face of the bat
good length delivery on off, as Samson pushes that to long-on from deep in his crease
reverse-sweeps to third man! Prepares early to attack this full ball outside off, and beats short third man to his right
short in length on middle, and turning in. Pulled to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
full ball on middle, and pushed back to the bowler off the closed face of the bat
full delivery on off, and coming in too since this was another slower ball. Again that is pushed to point with the open face of the bat
short of a length and outside off. He dabs that to third man, and finds the gap between the wide-ish slip and point
slower ball on a good length on off at just 117kph. Lomror waits for that to come, and dabs that to point
very full and just outside off. Again Lomror opens the bat face, but drives it right to the man at cover-point
much fuller on off, and he opens the bat face to tap to point
change of pace first up on a scrambled seam and on a good length outside off. Pushed to third man
tossed up again, and slower too on a full length just outside off. Pushed to point
slow and full on off. He opens the bat face to tap that to point
inside edge to his drive, as Ashwin goes full on off
good length ball on middle, and turning in. Clipped to deep midwicket for a couple

dances down, and is stumped! Miller skipped down well too early, as Ashwin tossed that up full and just outside off. Miller is beaten by the flight and the slowness of the ball, and Pant has it easy behind the stumps. Ashwin strikes second ball, as Capitals edge ahead early. Royals three down in under five overs
full ball on middle, and sliding into the batter with a hint of turn into him. Miller misses his flick

another excellent catch by Pant, but... Samson reviews! Short delivery on off, and Samson goes to pull. But replays indicate the ball clipped his left shoulder, with no bat involved. And UltraEdge shows the ball went off the side of the grille after taking his shoulder, and so Samson survives. Nevertheless, Pant dived to his right to nab that after the ball flew off Samson's body. Phew!
and again. Fullish ball on off, and he opens the bat face to run that down to third man for another single
good length ball and just outside off. Samson dabs that to third man from close to his body
inside edge on to his pads, and enough to excite  Nortje for a leg before! Full ball on off, and straightening after pitching, as Samson gets an inside edge off his flick
again in the slot on that full length on off although this is fuller, and Samson again can only push that to mid-off
in the driving length just outside off at 147kph, but Samson finds the man at cover with his drive.
slower ball, and a full and a touch wide of off. Taps that to third man for another single
short delivery, and climbing on to the batter's chest. Samson fends at that uncomfortably, as Avesh gets good bounce
fuller ball on off, and he pushes that to mid-off. A quick run is gobbled
fullish length and just outside off. Dabbed to third man from close to his body
Miller withdraws his bat late, and gets that dab off the bottom half of the bat to third man, as Avesh goes full and just outside off
fullish in length on off, and tapped toward mid-off
very full on off, and clipped to deep midwicket. Ashwin gives the chase, as Miller grabs a couple
good, tight length on off, and he closes the bat face to clip that from deep in his crease to midwicket
short of a length ball on leg, and Miller swivels with his pull to play to long leg
fullish ball on middle and off, and defended to point off the outside edge as he tried to open the bat face
good length ball just outside off, and tapped to cover off the front foot

Capitals go up for a caught behind, but the umpire stays unmoved! But Pant reviews. There seemed like a clear sound when the ball passed the bat, as Jaiswal went driving at this full delivery in the channel outside off. And UltraEdge confirms an outside edge. No foot movement as he goes pushing at that, as Pant took it easy this time. Another blow for Royals really early into the innings

tickled behind to the keeper, and Pant grabs it really well to his low! Avesh sees Livingstone coming down early, and changes his pace to also bowl short of a length outside off. Livingstone has a swing at that, but is foxed by the lack of pace, as the ball takes his a faint edge to go toward Pant, who dives low to complete the ctach
good length ball and just outside off. Tapped to the point fielder, with a loud call of "no"
upper cuts that over the point fielder, and pockets two more. Short and wide-ish of off, as Jaiswal rides the bounce to lift that. Third man gives the chase to his left
good length ball and closer to off. Punched off the back foot to the man at cover
slashed to third man! That is shortish and wide of off, and he cuts from deep in his crease to beat the diving point fielder to his right
steps forward and across right away. Fullish ball outside off, and pushed forward to the left of mid-off
